Question: ASSALUALEKUM,my sister got engaged to mashhood hussain warsi he is barelli thougt follower and is mureed of warispak of dewasharif.recemtly my sister saw a dream as if she is in bathroom and mashhood comes there and he has snake in his sleeves ,snakes fall down suddenly from his sleeves when she asked him mashhood said his peeromurshid had given him this snake and wahi comes on this snake so i can tell future,mashood told farah that he will give her some fishes and then she can also tell the future. MY SISTER IS NOW CONFUSED PLEASE GUIDE ME WHAT THIS DREAM SYMBOLIZE AND WHAT SHOULD WE DECIDE ABOUT THIS ENGAGEMENT. Answer ID: 12769 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 742/560=L/1430) The dream indicates that the proposal will not be suitable. Revelation of wahy on snake and telling the future is against the beliefs mentioned in the Quran and Hadith. Therefore, it is better to cancel the proposal and marry her with any pious boy having sound beliefs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
